scientific_integrity: The all-parameter integral representation is proved by a relative homology exact sequence; finite checks are corroboration and do not establish infinite scope. Existing nonequivariant sphere-wedge result is attributed as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Applies to ordinary Morse complexes of trees with at least two identical two-edge arms and their natural arm-permutation actions, not arbitrary tree automorphisms. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Integral branch-permutation homology of extended-star Morse complexes
